/domains/*/assessment/enforced: Finds the DMARC record that applies to the domain with RFC 9989's DNS tree walk. Checks for p=reject on the domain's own record, or a subdomain policy of reject on a record above it, without t=y.
/domains/*/assessment/has_reporting: Finds the DMARC record that applies to the domain with RFC 9989's DNS tree walk. Checks that its rua tag lists at least one URI with a scheme, such as mailto:. An entry with whitespace inside it is not a URI.
/domains/*/dkim/*/valid: Checks that no tag name appears twice in the record. Checks that its p tag is not empty and is base64 once whitespace is removed. The decoded key is not checked further.
/domains/*/dmarc/pct: Reads the record's pct tag, and uses 100 when the tag is missing or is not a whole number from 0 to 100.
/domains/*/dmarc/valid: Parses the record as RFC 9989 defines it. A record with a missing or invalid p tag, or an invalid sp or np tag, is valid only when it lists a valid rua URI.
/domains/*/mx/*/priority: Reads the preference value of each MX record the domain's MX lookup returns.
/domains/*/spf/valid: Checks that the domain publishes one SPF record and that every term in it matches RFC 7208's grammar. The record also needs a mechanism, or a redirect or exp modifier.
/summary/enforced_count: Counts the domains whose assessment.enforced is true.
/summary/total_domains: Counts the domains listed in the config.
/summary/with_all_three_count: Counts the domains with at least one MX record, an SPF record, and a DMARC record that applies to them.
/summary/with_dkim_count: Looks up nine common DKIM selectors on each domain and counts the domains where any of them has a DKIM record. A DKIM record needs a p tag, and its v tag must be exactly DKIM1 when present. Tag names are case-sensitive.
/summary/with_dmarc_count: Counts the domains for which RFC 9989's DNS tree walk finds a DMARC record, at _dmarc under the domain or under a parent domain.
/summary/with_mx_count: Counts the domains whose MX lookup returns at least one record.
/summary/with_reporting_count: Counts the domains whose assessment.has_reporting is true.
/summary/with_spf_count: Counts the domains with a TXT record that starts with v=spf1.
